description: Review holdings in one call ($0.25): up to 15 positions (symbol with valueUsd or quantity) and 5 on-chain tokens. Returns concentration, correlations, volatility and one-day 95% VaR from hourly on-chain data, the current decision per symbol, token risk verdicts, macro events in the next 24h, flags and a verdict (OK, REVIEW, HIGH_RISK).
name: check_portfolio
